FOREWORD

0.1 This I~ndian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 8 June 1978, after the draft finalized by the Dye Intermediates Sectional Committee had been approved by the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council. 0.2 1, 4-Dichloro-2-nitrobenzene ( C&&O~NCIZ ) is an important dye It is represented by the intermediate used in the manufacture of dyes. following structural formula:

1, 4-Dichloro-2-Nitrobenzene

Mass 192 )

A-4.2.9 Sodium Hydroxide Solution A-4.3 Procedure

( m/u ).

A-4.3.1 Weigh 1 g each of the pure 1, 4-dichloro-2-nitrobenzene into 4 beakers of 500-ml capacity each. Weigh O-1 g of 3, 4-dichloronitrobenzene into a dry 100-ml volumetric flask, dissolve and make up to volume with glacial acetic acid. Pipette out (using a safety pipette ) 0.5 ml, 1 ml, 2 ml and 3 ml of this acetic acid solution into the 4 beakers containing pure 1, 4-dichloro-2-nitrobenzene. Thus we have standards containing 0.05 percent, 0.1 percent, 0.2 percent and 0.3 percent of 3, 4-dichloronitrobenzene. NOW add 20 ml of glacial acitic acid to each beaker to dissolve the contents, warm, if necessary. Add 5 g of zinc dust to each beaker, followed by 10 ml of hydrochloric acid. Keep for 30 minutes. Again add 5 g more of zinc dust and 10 ml of Repeat the operation for a hydrochloric acid and keep for 30 minutes. Now make the contents of all the beakers alkaline using third time. sodium hydroxide solution. Add 25 ml of benzene and stir well to Transfer the benzene layer to a separating extract the amine formed. funnel by decantation. Repeat the extraction with two more instalments of 25 ml each of benzene and collect all the benzene extracts in the same Separate the benzene layer and transfer it into separating funnel. a lOO-ml volumetric flask. A-4.3.2 Prepare the amine extract of the material under same way as in the case of the four standards ( see A-4.3.1 ). test in the

A-4.3.3 Spot 10 microlitre each of the sample solution and the four standards on the thin layer plate. Allow to dry and keep the plate in Allow to run for the developing chamber containing benzene solvent. Take out the plate and allow to dry. Keep the plate about 30 minutes. for 2 minutes in a chamber containing nitrous acid fumes ( prepared by mixing sodium nitrite and hydrochloric acid ). Blow out the excess nitrous fumes from the plate and spray with the spraying reagent. The sample and the impurities are seen as violet spots. The material has Rf value of 0.95 and the 3, 4-dichloronitrobenzene 0.69. Compare the intensity of the impurity in the sample to the nearest in the standards. 7
